notes.title: Playtest 2 - patch notes
notes.content:
[b]Ability Rank System[/b]
Gain experience and upgrade your abilities with the new ranking system.

[b]Mining Gameplay Mechanic (activated with F key)[/b]
A new gameplay feature: deploy your drone to mine valuable elements during gameplay. Press [b]F[/b] to activate.

[b]Main Menu Ship Visual Modifications[/b]
Customize your ship's appearance directly from the main menu.

[b]Sector01 Visual Improvements[/b]
Sector01 has received a visual upgrade for a more immersive atmosphere.

notes.title: Abilities level and mining resources
notes.content:
